import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int YearUniversityAdmission(int n, int[] arr) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < n; ++idx) {
            total += arr[idx];
        }
        return total / n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) {
            return;
        }
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int[] years = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            years[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        System.out.print(YearUniversityAdmission(n, years) + "\n");
        sc.close();
    }
}
